findings.claim: The runtime Claude adapter status ignored the agent key and said supported while status-hooks warned. Fixed in 92f65588 (mainAgentStatus through settings.MainAgent) and 1e6d6cdb (the inspection is part of the HookInstaller port, no type assertion).
evidence: judge A round 1 on 9091d9ce; bounded recheck A and B on 65894e6f found it fixed.

findings.claim: Same as A-F1, plus the Claude installation claim did not mention the key. Fixed in 92f65588.
evidence: judge B round 1; bounded recheck found declarations.go:36-46 naming the key and citing three runtime tests that exist.

findings.claim: The runtime install and update left a foreign agent value silently. Fixed in 92f65588: both append settings.ForeignMainAgentNotice, the builder merge-settings also uses.
evidence: judge B round 1; bounded recheck B confirmed one shared builder.

findings.claim: No command-level tests read the file back. Fixed in 92f65588 (merge-settings keeps a foreign value and writes .bak; uninstall-hooks removes foreman only; status notes asserted).
evidence: judge B round 1; bounded recheck B read lines 23-93.

findings.claim: Ownership by value: a hand-written "foreman" is removed on uninstall. Kept by design: "foreman" names the agent file this overlay installs (overlay.manifest foreman.md), so uninstall must not leave the key pointing at it; stated in the code comment and README.
evidence: judges A round 1 and the regular review of f95a3624; answered in the Log.

findings.claim: A JSON null agent value is a conflict. Kept: null is a value the user wrote and is never overwritten; status and the notice name it.
evidence: judge B round 1; answered in the Log.

Two blind polisher judges read the 9091d9ce tree (f95a3624..9091d9ce) on a detached worktree; findings attributed to f95a3624, which introduced the key. The independent verifier passed the suite, vet, gofmt and sandbox-HOME probes of six inputs plus two rejected files against the f3cbdc30 base: foreign values identical, second install a no-op, uninstall removes only foreman, rejected runs leave the hash unchanged, output differs only by the status line and the notice.
